entities.name: Shoshana Arbeli-Almozlino
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shoshana Arbeli-Almozlino was an Israeli politician who served as a member of the Knesset for the Labor Party and the Alignment alliance from 1965 until 1992. She was also Minister of Health between 1986 and 1988.
